description: Implementation of the DeviceVideoCapabilities class, providing methods to retrieve supported video display options, EDID data, default resolution, supported resolutions, and HDCP support, with error handling and interaction with hardware interface classes.

classes.name: DeviceVideoCapabilities
classes.description: Implements capabilities related to device video output, including retrieval of supported video displays, EDID data, default resolution, supported resolutions, and HDCP support, with initialization and registration.

methods.name: DeviceVideoCapabilities
methods.description: Constructor that initializes IARM interface and device manager, with exception handling and logging.

methods.name: SupportedVideoDisplays
methods.description: Returns a list of unique supported video display names by querying video output ports, handling exceptions.

methods.name: HostEDID
methods.description: Retrieves the EDID information from the host, encodes it in base64, and handles exceptions.

methods.name: DefaultResolution
methods.description: Fetches the default resolution for a specified or default video display port.

methods.name: SupportedResolutions
methods.description: Returns a list of supported resolution names for a specified or default video display port.

methods.name: SupportedHdcp
methods.description: Provides the HDCP copy protection protocol supported by a specified or default video port.
